tagline: Authentic Mexican Homestyle Cooking Served with Generous West New York Heart
address: 6005 Hudson Ave, West New York, NJ 07093, USA

storyBlock.headline: Traditional Mexican Soul, Welcomed Like Family
storyBlock.narrative: Every plate at Fonda Hudson is crafted with generational recipes, bold authentic spices, and generous portions that feed the soul. You are greeted with genuine warmth and personal care the instant you walk through our doors on Hudson Avenue.

highlights.label: Homestyle Promise
highlights.value: Generous Recipes Made Daily from Scratch

services.name: Signature Birria Tacos
services.description: Slow-braised beef birria with melted Oaxaca cheese in crisp corn tortillas, served with rich cilantro-onion consommé.

services.name: Enchiladas Verdes Michoacanas
services.description: Tender shredded chicken wrapped in corn tortillas, covered in tangy tomatillo salsa, queso fresco, and Mexican crema.

services.name: Daily Chalkboard Lunch Special
services.description: Chef's daily homestyle entree served alongside seasoned rice, slow-simmered beans, and handmade corn tortillas.

services.name: Abuelita’s Family Fiesta Pack
services.description: Generous feast for 4-5 including your choice of two meats, warm tortillas, rice, beans, fresh salsas, and churros.

reviews.author: sophia
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible. Some of the best food I’ve ever had. The owner was super nice and gave us recs and insights on the area. Incredible value for the price! Can’t recommend enough.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.text: This place quickly became a favorite for me. Great attention and customer service that instantly made me feel welcomed. Prices and portion sizes are great and the food better. Great place for a solo meal or family visit. Definitely would recommend everything b

reviews.author: gabriella
reviews.text: This restaurant is phenomenal! The food is out of this world, i’ve never had better. And for a great price. The owner was so kind and caring to us and catered to all of our needs! He went above and beyond, even giving us advice on things to do in town. I 11/10
